hairline.note: Alpha overlay of ink; no tonal ramp — vary alpha (.10 regular, .18 strong), not lightness.

hairline-strong.note: Alpha overlay of ink; outer borders and link underlines.

go-glow.note: Alpha bloom of go-lens; lamp box-shadow only.

hold-glow.note: Alpha bloom of hold-lens; lamp box-shadow only.

spend-glow.note: Alpha bloom of spend-lens; lamp box-shadow only.

display.purpose: Masthead headline only. Archivo compressed to wdth 78; stacked spans, one line per thought; the charged line takes spend-ink.

lede.purpose: Masthead standfirst in ink-dim, max 56ch; bold runs get ink at weight 600.

body.purpose: Prose at wdth 100, held to the 68ch measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase equipment labels: wdth 84, tracked 0.17em, ink-faint. State words/badges are the same voice at 0.62-0.63rem / 0.15em tracking in state ink; table headers at 0.66rem / 0.15em.

code.purpose: JetBrains Mono for anything executable: blocks at 0.82rem/1.72, inline at 0.88em, station numbers 0.78rem, timestamps 0.73rem, costs 0.68rem.

shadows.name: console-frame
shadows.purpose: The signal rail only — the heaviest object on the page.

shadows.name: raised-panel
shadows.purpose: Step panels and the timeline readout. Inset top-light + deep soft shadow + tight contact shadow, always all three.

shadows.name: bolted-plate
shadows.purpose: Rail stations — no drop shadow, a plate is fastened to the frame, not floating.

shadows.name: recessed-well
shadows.purpose: Code blocks, sunk into the housing.

shadows.name: lens-stack
shadows.purpose: Lamps only: dark seat ring, glass highlight, machined bezel, contact shadow, coloured bloom. --glow swaps per state (go/hold/spend glow tokens); transparent when unlit.

motion.name: ease-mechanical
motion.purpose: The only easing on the page; used by every transition and the energize animation.

motion.name: energize
motion.purpose: The one authored moment. Keyframes on filter: 0% saturate(.28) brightness(.42) -> 38% saturate(1.35) brightness(1.5) -> 100% saturate(1.18) brightness(1.06). Fired by adding .is-lit when the group scrolls into view (IntersectionObserver, threshold .35). Lamps are lit by default in CSS; this only adds the warm-up.

motion.name: stagger-rail
motion.purpose: Per-station delay when the rail energizes.

motion.name: stagger-legend
motion.purpose: Per-cell delay when the legend energizes.

motion.name: surface-transition
motion.purpose: Station hover: the metal's finish changes, never its position or shadow. No transform animation exists anywhere. prefers-reduced-motion disables all motion.

breakpoints.name: single-column
breakpoints.purpose: Rail and timeline to 1 column; fault table drops its header row and reflows rows as blocks.

narrative.overview:
The walkthrough page (walkthrough.html) is built as a piece of club equipment: the Toastmasters timing light reimagined as a documentation grammar. The world is a machined instrument console — warm graphite housing, panels bolted to a frame, ivory lettering silkscreened onto metal — and the only colour on it comes from three lamp lenses. Green means a step is free and deterministic, amber means a person must look before anything ships, red means real credits are spent on an untrustworthy generator. Colour is never decoration; every coloured element is a literal claim about what a step costs.

Scope boundary, and it is load-bearing: this system governs walkthrough.html only. The card templates in templates/ are a separate, deliberately different visual system that follows Toastmasters International brand rules (Loyal Blue, Happy Yellow, Montserrat) because the video output must. The walkthrough page deliberately does not, so the page cannot be mistaken for an official TI property — the repo's non-affiliation notice depends on the two systems never merging. Do not carry tokens in either direction.

The atmosphere is calm, dense with information but generous with rhythm: fluid clamp() spacing throughout, prose held to a strict measure, and depth rendered as physical machining (inset top-lights, offset drop shadows, screw-head fasteners) rather than as floating cards. Motion is a single authored moment — lamps energizing like incandescent bulbs — and everything else holds still.
keyCharacteristics: Three signal colours (green / amber / red) carrying literal go / hold / spend states; everything else is desaturated graphite and ivory
Machined-hardware depth: inset edge highlights, paired drop shadows, bolted plates, recessed wells
Archivo variable font with an active width axis (narrow display, compressed silkscreen labels); JetBrains Mono for anything executable
Lit-by-default lamps: pure-CSS components that read correctly with no JavaScript
One keyframe animation on the whole page; layout never moves

rules.name: The Three Lamps Rule
rules.body: Green, amber, and red are the page's only chromatic colours, and each is a literal state. Never add a fourth signal colour, and never use a signal tint decoratively — a coloured element is a claim about what a step costs.

rules.name: The Lens-and-Ink Rule
rules.body: Every state has a lens value and a lightened ink value. Lenses go on lamp glass, glows, and tinted surfaces; inks go on type against graphite (the lightening is what keeps small text legible on dark panels). Never set text in a lens colour.

rules.name: The No-Pure-White Rule
rules.body: #FFF never appears as a fill or text colour; the brightest ink is #F6F3EC. Pure white exists only inside gradients and inset highlights at low alpha (specular glints on lenses and panel edges).

rules.name: The Silkscreen Rule
rules.body: Anything that labels hardware — plates, state words, column headers — is uppercase, weight 700, compressed to wdth 84, and tracked wide (0.15–0.17em) at under 0.7rem. Headings run the opposite direction: as size grows, the width axis narrows (headline 92 → display 78) and letter-spacing tightens. Width and tracking always move together.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Executable Rule
rules.body: JetBrains Mono is reserved for the machine register: commands, filenames, config values, station numbers, timestamps, credit costs. It is never used for emphasis or decoration.

rules.name: The Machined Edge Rule
rules.body: A raised surface always carries all three parts: 1px inset top-light, a deep soft shadow, and a tight contact shadow. A recessed surface uses inset shadows only. Nothing floats with a single ambient shadow, and shadows never respond to hover — hover changes the metal's finish (background gradient), not its height.

rules.name: The Nesting Radius Rule
rules.body: Radius steps down with depth: 12px console → 8px well → 4–5px cell → 3px badge. A child surface never has a larger radius than its parent.

rules.name: The Lit-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Lamps render fully lit in pure CSS (filter: saturate(1.18) brightness(1.06)). JavaScript only adds the warm-up; a lamp must never depend on script to read correctly.

dos: Do assign every step, station, and badge exactly one state class (go / hold / spend) and let the class colour lamp, word, and badge together — never colour those pieces individually.
Do keep lamps legible without JavaScript; script may only add the energize warm-up and stagger.
Do hold prose to the 68ch measure even inside wide panels, and keep all page-level spacing fluid (clamp()), reserving exact pixels for hardware details (fasteners, rail gaps, hairlines).
Do build dividers as etched hairlines — ivory at .10/.18 alpha, or 1px grid gaps over the hairline colour — rather than opaque borders.

Do set anything executable (commands, filenames, config values, numbers on plates) in JetBrains Mono, and every hardware label in the compressed silkscreen voice (uppercase, wdth 84, 0.15–0.17em tracking).
Do honour prefers-reduced-motion by disabling the energize animation and transitions entirely, as the page already does.
donts: Don't use Toastmasters International brand elements on this page — no Loyal Blue #004165, no Happy Yellow #F2DF74, no Montserrat, no TI logo. Those bind the video templates in templates/; the walkthrough page must stay visually independent or the non-affiliation notice stops being credible.
Don't add a fourth signal colour, use go/hold/spend tints decoratively, or set text in a lens value — type takes the lightened ink variant only.
Don't give the spend treatment (tinted border, tinted head gradient, warn callout) to anything that is not the credit-spending hazard; its rarity is the argument.

Don't move layout: no transform animations, no hover lifts, no parallax. Hover changes a surface's finish (background), never its position or shadow, and the energize filter is the only keyframe animation allowed.
Don't use pure #FFF or pure #000 as fills or text; the extremes are ink-bright #F6F3EC and housing-deep #15181C, with white/black reserved for low-alpha gradient light and shade.
Don't introduce a docs sidebar or sticky table of contents; the signal rail's anchor stations are the navigation, and the single-column shell is a thesis decision, not a gap.
